label: No intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being
paraphrase: Derived conditional bridge (its premises remain open), analyst formulation, attribution deferred (no claim states it). For every g and x: if g is INFINITE_1, x has intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1) and x is not INFINITE_1, then x does not comprehend g (Comprehends, COMPREHEND_1, the primitive relation of definition 4afe4ab4: knowing as perfectly as knowable). Since 2026-11-12 it is derived (finiteIntellectDoesNotComprehendInfiniteByMeasure, specs/comprehension-by-measure.toml) from its COMPREHEND_2 sibling, itself derived from four open premises on a degree scale (an INFINITE_1 being has a maximal degree of act; everything is knowable at least to the degree it is in act; what is not INFINITE_1 has a non-maximal degree of act; nothing knows at a degree above its own degree of act), and the open sense bridge 'Whatever COMPREHEND_1s a being COMPREHEND_2s it'. After ST I q.12 a.7: God is infinitely knowable, being infinite act, and no created intellect knows him infinitely, since its power of knowing, even raised by the light of glory, is finite. The bridge reads 'finite intellect' as an intellect whose being is not INFINITE_1, so it also carries the step from finite being to finite power of knowing; on the measured route that step is the two premises about non-INFINITE_1 act and knowing within the knower's act, and 'infinitely knowable' is the two premises about INFINITE_1 act and knowability insofar as in act. It says nothing about whether such an intellect knows g truly (q.12 a.7 ad 1: the blessed attain God without comprehending him) and nothing about g's knowing itself. Lead, not an objection: finite minds grasp quantitative infinities through finite principles (a definition fixes the natural numbers); its relevance to INFINITE_1 (unlimited act) is not shown, and it is weaker than it looks, since incompleteness cuts toward finite minds not knowing the natural numbers as perfectly as they are knowable. Control part 4: without it, a being with the nine can be comprehended by a caused intellect and is not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2.
